caption:
Your farthest customers might be costing you money.

Most owners chase a bigger radius before they've filled the one they already have. Run this before you expand:

1. Map your last 90 days of jobs on a radius from your shop
2. Cost the drive time at your real crew-and-vehicle rate, not just the labor
3. Don't target a farther zip code until your closest ring is turning away work

A tight radius keeps the 5-minute callback possible on every job.
